basic_details.offering_entity: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All 8 New Zealand Universities (Auckland, Otago, Victoria Wellington, Canterbury, Massey, Waikato, Lincoln, AUT)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Target development sectors: Climate Change & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Disaster Risk Management, Food Security & Agriculture, Sustainable Governance.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~500 scholars selected globally across partner developing countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan as an eligible Commonwealth country under Asia regional quota
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Postgraduate Diploma (1 year), Master's degree (1 to 2 years), PhD (up to 3.5 years)

nationality_requirements: Citizen of an eligible country (including Pakistan) residing in home country for at least 2 years prior to application
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Minimum age is 18 years at commencement; no upper age limit, but applicants under 40 years are preferred.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of education (Bachelor's) for Master's; 18 years (Master's with thesis) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum B grade equivalent (3.0 / 4.00 CGPA or 65%+ marks in annual system).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with New Zealand priority development sectors.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated and currently employed in home country.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Minimum 1 year of full-time work experience (or 2 years part-time) related to chosen field of study.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 90 (writing 21) required for Master's; IELTS 6.5-7.0 for PhD.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; female applicants and marginalized community members encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Development impact and firm commitment to return to Pakistan for a minimum of two years.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another scholarship concurrently; previous New Zealand scholarship recipients must satisfy stand-down period.

tuition_fee.details: Full international tuition fees and compulsory university student services levies.

monthly_stipend.details: Fortnightly living allowance paid to cover accommodation, food, and living expenses.

airfare.details: Economy class return flights from Pakistan to New Zealand, plus reunion travel flights for long multi-year awards.

visa_fee.details: Student visa medical examination and visa application fees covered.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive travel and medical insurance (Studentsafe-University) fully covered.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Establishment allowance paid upon arrival in New Zealand.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Postgraduate thesis research allowance provided for master's and PhD research students.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host universities across New Zealand.
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: All 8 state universities ranked within QS World Top 500.
available_majors: Climate Change & Adaptation, Renewable Energy, Environmental Engineering, Food Technology, Agribusiness, Disaster Risk Management, Public Policy, Indigenous Governance, Natural Resource Management
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 to 2 years for Master's; 3.5 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Select preferred New Zealand universities and programs on the Manaaki portal; university admissions coordinated after scholarship shortlisting.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Lincoln and Massey are world-renowned for Agriculture; Auckland and Canterbury for Engineering.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align your proposed degree explicitly with Pakistan's National Climate Change Policy or renewable energy targets.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Complete the online eligibility questionnaire to verify country and sector eligibility, then create applicant account.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Take online eligibility test on Manaaki portal (Opens February).
2. If eligible, complete online application form.
3. Write development impact statements explaining how study will address home country challenges.
4. Submit online application by closing date (typically end of February).
6. Shortlisted candidates invited for video interview (June-July).
7. Final selections announced August-September; placement confirmed with NZ universities.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct application via Manaaki MFAT portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees during shortlisting stage.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Explain how your proposed study will contribute to the sustainable economic and social development of Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of coursework or research objectives (PhD applicants require brief outline of research focus).
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard employment and education history entered into online portal.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Semi-structured competency-based interview conducted via video conference by New Zealand selection panel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT required after shortlisting.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree and transcripts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Certified copies of undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Certified by degree-awarding university in Pakistan

required_documents_checklist.specification: Employment letter confirming minimum 1 year relevant work experience
Valid IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+)
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Test score must be valid at commencement of study in New Zealand

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Application window is very short: opens February 1 and closes end of February each year.

selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 25% (Development impact of proposed study on Pakistan)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT) selection committees and development specialists.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Assessment of academic aptitude, development relevance, and applicant's likelihood of driving sustainable change in home country.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~10,000+ applicants across all eligible partner countries
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Mid-career professionals working in government agencies, environmental NGOs, or renewable energy companies with concrete career plans.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Engineers in provincial energy departments, disaster management officers (NDMA/PDMA), agricultural researchers.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pacific Island nations, Southeast Asia, South Asia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Websites charging fees for Manaaki scholarship application assistance.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Manaaki application is 100% free of charge.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do NOT use education agents; applications submitted by agents are flagged and disqualified.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fee in Pakistan (~PKR 55,000 to 65,000).
Immigration medical examination by panel physician in Pakistan (~PKR 25,000).
Courier charges for physical document dispatch if required.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can stay and seek New Zealand permanent residency immediately after study. (Fact: MANDATORY 2-year return to home country is legally binding under visa regulations).
MYTH: Any subject can be studied. (Fact: Only designated development priority sectors are eligible).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External blogs list outdated application deadlines; the window closes strictly in late February.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all courses and maintain satisfactory academic standing per New Zealand university regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment on campus in New Zealand.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities provide regular progress updates to MFAT.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may work up to 20 hours/week during term-time per New Zealand student visa conditions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: MANDATORY 2-Year Return: Scholars must return to their home country for a minimum of two years upon completion to apply skills to development.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Legal undertaking signed with the New Zealand Government.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholars who fail to return home or breach scholarship terms may be required to repay the full scholarship cost.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing institutions is not permitted except in exceptional circumstances with MFAT approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Extensions are strictly granted only for unavoidable medical or academic research delays approved by MFAT.
